created_prompt: I would like you to help me create a three-year plan to grow my online presence and publish a cookbook.  My channel consists of quick, healthy recipes and currently has 1.2M followers. The goal of the plan is to grow the number of followers and to publish a cookbook, either through traditional publishing or self-publishing (I would like your insight on what would be better for me). Things to take into account: I work four days a week; therefore, I have little free time, and my budget is also limited. Present the plan in a clear, structured way.
